description: You are a Monitoring & Evaluation Officer for the Sierra Leone Ministry of Health. You need to create a performance scorecard for the Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI). Using DHIS2 at http://localhost:8080 (login: admin / district): (1) Navigate to the Maintenance app and create a new Legend Set named 'EPI Coverage Performance'. Define three legend items (performance tiers) with specific colors: 'Low' (0-50, Red), 'Medium' (50-80, Yellow/Orange), and 'High' (80-100+, Green). (2) Navigate to the Data Visualizer app and create a Pivot Table showing immunization coverage (use 'Penta 3' or 'DPT 3' data elements/indicators) by District for the year 2023. (3) Apply your new 'EPI Coverage Performance' legend set to this visualization. (4) Save the visualization as a favorite named 'District Immunization Scorecard 2023'.
